answer: The velvet graph is rebuilt each epoch, and as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the lagoon audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 5 times its size, so a group of 77 keys loses far more than 77 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the glacier checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. That is 4 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
